[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The consistency of this isnt bad, it's more of a milky serum. It doesn't absorb very well, just kind of sits on my skin. I understand I could just have an allergy, so I did a little research on the ingredients. The hyaluronic acid obviously isn't the issue, and I've used vitamin c before with no issues. So I'm thinking it may be one of the peptides. I'm not expert, but here's what Dr. Google says. The three peptides are: 1: Matrixyl 3000 which is used to stimulate the skin to produce more collagen 2: Argireline (considered a cosmetic apparently) which inhibits the release of neurotransmitters that signal facial muscles to contract, thus reducing muscle movement 3: Carnosine which is an antioxidant I tried to power through this and use it every few days, but it's just not worth it.
